routes.name: ASAN eVisa
routes.summary: Apply online for an electronic visa to Azerbaijan. There is a standard single-entry visa and an urgent option decided within 3 hours. Eligible nationalities, fees and stay length are not confirmed here.

other: Eligible nationalities, fee and validity not read on an official page. Check evisa.gov.az.

routes.processing: Urgent eVisa applications are considered in 3 hours, per the portal.

routes.name: Work Permit and Temporary Residence
routes.summary: Your employer applies for the work permit. It is only given if no qualified Azerbaijani citizen can fill the job. You also need a temporary residence permit.

other: Fee amounts not published on the page. Some groups, like highly skilled migrants and spouses of citizens, don't need a work permit.

stay.note: Issued for one year or the contract term if shorter. Each extension is up to one year.

routes.name: Temporary Residence Permit
routes.summary: Issued on set grounds, including family ties to a citizen, work permit, full-time study, entrepreneurship, being a highly skilled migrant, or investment. Usually valid up to 1 year and extendable.

other: Real estate worth at least AZN 100,000, or a fixed-term deposit or government securities of at least AZN 100,000, can be a ground.
Investment of at least AZN 500,000 can be a ground.
Fee amount not stated on the page.

sources.label: State Migration Service: temporary and permanent residence

stay.note: Extended by up to 2 years each time. Highly skilled migrants can get up to 3 years, extendable by up to 3 years.

documents: Passport valid more than 3 months past the permit

routes.name: Investor Residence
routes.summary: Temporary residence based on investment or property. Permanent residence is possible with larger amounts.

investment.note: Business investment. Real estate or a bank deposit or government securities of AZN 100,000 also qualifies for temporary residence.

sources.label: State Migration Service: temporary and permanent residence

routes.name: Permanent Residence Permit
routes.summary: Generally needs at least 2 years on temporary residence, with some exceptions. Valid 5 years and renewable without limit. You must pass a test on Azerbaijani laws and the language unless exempt.

eligibility.language: Test on Azerbaijani laws and the official language, unless exempt
other: Exempt from the test: highly skilled migrants, under 18, age 65 and over, 81 to 100 percent disability.
Proof of sufficient funds, with exceptions.
Investment of AZN 500,000, or property, deposit or securities of AZN 200,000, can be a ground.
Fee amount not stated on the page.

sources.label: State Migration Service: temporary and permanent residence
